description: Hebrew term canonicalization gold standard. Tests canonicalize_hebrew_term() and choose_representative_term().
notes: Pipeline: strip_nikud → strip_cantillation → normalize_quotes → normalize_whitespace → filter standalone single-char Hebrew prefix tokens → strip_prefixes per token (need 3+ chars remaining) → join with _ → lowercase → strip non-Hebrew/number/Latin chars.

With definite article ה on second word
With prefix ב on first word (בבית → בית after stripping)
With prefix ל on first word
